Observe first. Explain precisely.

Recording-level annotation

Measured level
RMS -22.01 dBFS; sample peak -3.70 dBFS. Zero samples at or above 0.999 full scale. This does not establish the absence of audible distortion.
Intelligibility and interference
Not assessed by listening. Noise, compression artifacts, reverb, music, audible clipping, dropouts, distortion, and overlapping voices remain pending.
Perceptual cues and origin
Human and synthetic cues not assessed. Perceived origin: uncertain; confidence: unassigned. No detector inference was used.
Escalation / next review
Listen at original speed, inspect the quiet intervals, and check the cropped endpoint for an interrupted word. Distinguish ordinary pauses from dropouts. Add perceptual labels only after listening.
Reference disclosure
Source corpus identifies genuine audiobook speech. This example is reference-informed and must not count toward blind-review accuracy or independent agreement.

Timestamped observations

Every five-second interval is measured. Additional quiet spans use a fixed -40 dBFS RMS rule over 20 ms frames, for at least 200 ms. Click an interval to play it; ordinary playback remains available above.
